item.title: Russel square, 25th October
item.description:
We visited russel square today and my 2 year old son stood behind this bench and jumped holding the back rest. It was not secured and the entire heavy bench fell back on him. He was hit right on his chest and lost his breath. Afterwards I noticed screws had come off on both sides and this was clearly not a recent issue. Completely unacceptable, this could have ended really badly. Strangely a few minutes after the incident I saw someone who works in the square took photos of the bench and soon after removed it from the site. This someone must have witnessed this accident and instead of approaching us to check we were fine waited until we had left to do the necessary work.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 52-53, Russell Square, Bloomsbury, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
